newsitem.title: UK: June Forties programme set lower at 17.3 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: June Forties programme set lower at 17.3 mln bbls.

text.p: June's U.K. North Sea Forties programme schedules liftings totalling 17.3 million barrels, down from 22.45 million in May, traders said on Friday.
The difference, 5.15 million barrels, is the equivalent of 10.3 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes less than the original May schedule.

The June programme is made up of 11 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 14 of 500,000 barrels, two of 700,000 barrels and two of 400,000 barrels with a further 1.5 million barrels which will go direct to Forties pipeline operator BP's refinery at Grangemouth.

Maintenance work is scheduled at BP's Forties A, C and E platforms in the first week of the month, at BP's Bruce platform for the first half of June, at Enterprise's 167,000 barrels per day (bpd) Nelson field also for the first half and at Amerada Hess' 184,000 bpd Scott/Telford fields on June 9-11.
June being a day shorter than May, daily liftings of Forties should run at 576,000 bpd compared to 724,000 bpd in the May programme.
Forties loads at BP's Hound Point terminal in eastern Scotland.
